conventions.convention: Assume AC and characteristic-zero coefficients. G is a finite product of complex general linear groups acting algebraically on a separated finite-type complex variety, equipped with its analytic topology.

The equivariant category is the full subcategory of the bounded derived category of simplicial sheaves with Cartesian cohomology and constructible degree-zero restriction. Boundedness is uniform in simplicial degree. Morphisms are ambient derived morphisms, rather than morphisms in the derived category of naive equivariant sheaves.
Use cochain shifts H^j(A[m]) = H^(j+m)(A), and Ext_G^m(A,B) = Hom(A,B[m]). The action nerve starts at simplicial degree zero and generally has no augmentation to X.
Full-rank frames have right action u·g = ug; the associated quotient uses (u,x)·g = (ug,g⁻¹x). For N_i ≥ n_i+1, the cohomology-gap bound is r_N = 2 min_i(N_i−n_i).

For interval [b,a], full faithfulness, the truncated-counit image criterion and retract closure require a−b ≤ r. Extension closure requires the stronger bound r ≥ a−b+1. The product comparison is local and does not assert a global tensor splitting.
The normalized equivariant dualizing object restricts to ordinary ω_X. At a frame quotient it is ω_(X_N)[−2s_N], where s_N = dim_C B_N; for smooth d-dimensional X it is k_X[2d].
Perverse normalization is Q_N(A)[s_N], with s_N = u_N−g = dim_C B_N. The equivariant perverse aisles are detected by ordinary restriction to X.

Middle perversity uses support vanishing above −dim_C S and cosupport vanishing below −dim_C S. Intersection complexes use L[dim_C Z]. A simple object's endomorphism algebra is a division k-algebra, without an assertion that it equals k.

load_bearing.statement: Under AC, for the stated product-GL action on a separated finite-type complex variety and its Stiefel resolutions, Hom_G(A,B[m]) ≅ Hom_(X_N)(Q_N(A),Q_N(B)[m]) when A ≤ a, B ≥ b and m ≤ b+r_N−a. Q_N is fully faithful on ordinary intervals of width at most r_N; its image is characterized by principal-bundle pullback coming from X, with retract closure and extension closure under r_N ≥ a−b+1. Comparisons on product resolutions are coherent. For the trivial group Q_N is the identity and r_N = ∞.

Under AC, for characteristic-zero k and the stated product-GL action, D^b_(G,c)(X;k) is the full subcategory of D^b(Sh_k(G^bullet×X)) consisting of uniformly bounded complexes with Cartesian cohomology and algebraically constructible degree-zero restriction; Ext_G^m(A,B) = Hom(A,B[m]).

Under AC, the defined equivariant constructible category is locally small, triangulated and idempotent complete, with conservative restriction to X. Coinduced simplicial injectives compute its morphisms, and locally split free-action descent realizes the bounded Stiefel resolution-triple comparisons, including the degree-zero ring comparison and retract closure. Derived full faithfulness of restriction to X is not asserted.

Under AC and characteristic-zero coefficients, equivariant algebraic maps in the stated product-GL setting carry the coherent bounded constructible six operations and their adjunctions, composition, localization, projection and trace. Cartesian exchange is u*Rf_! ≅ Rf'_!v* and its dual mate u!Rf_* ≅ Rf'_*v!; proper f has Rf_! = Rf_*. The normalized dualizing object restricts to ordinary ω_X and equals k_X[2d] for smooth complex d-dimensional X.

Under AC in the stated frame-resolution setting, the equivariant middle-perverse structure is detected by restriction to X and by Q_N(A)[s_N], where s_N = u_N−g. Normalized comparison is perverse exact and conservative; sufficiently large resolutions lift perverse truncations canonically. At the degree-zero Hom bound r_N ≥ a−b, orthogonal idempotents lift, and normalization preserves and reflects perverse concentration and simplicity.

Under AC and the explicitly stated finite constructible local-product and pushforward hypotheses, a bundle with nonempty connected smooth fibre satisfying H^0(F;k)=k and H^j(F;k)=0 for 1≤j≤r has unit cone in D^(≥b+r+1) on B≥b. Pullback identifies Hom(A,B[m]) for A≤a and m≤b+r−a, with interval full faithfulness and the truncated-counit image criterion for a−b≤r, retract closure there, and extension closure for r≥a−b+1.

Under AC, for s≥1, n_i≥1 and N_i≥n_i+1, U_N = product_i Inj(C^(n_i),C^(N_i)) has H^0(U_N;k)=k and H^j(U_N;k)=0 for 1≤j≤2 min_i(N_i−n_i), over any field k. Each frame factor retracts onto its compact path-connected smooth Stiefel manifold; forgetting the last frame vector is a numerable sphere bundle with fibre S^(2(N−n)+1).

Under AC and characteristic-zero coefficients in the defined equivariant category, the ordinary-restriction middle-perverse inequalities define a bounded t-structure independent of compatible refinement and gluing across invariant algebraic open/closed decompositions. Its heart is abelian of finite length; its simples are equivariant intersection complexes of simple finite-rank local systems on invariant dense smooth opens of irreducible invariant supports. Heart objects have no negative Hom, and simple endomorphism rings are division k-algebras.

Under AC, for bounded constructible objects in the stated characteristic-zero product-GL equivariant category, every Ext_G^m(A,B) is finite-dimensional and sufficiently negative degrees vanish. Every characteristic-zero field extension induces the natural Ext scalar-extension isomorphism, compatible with shifts and Yoneda composition, and commutes with the six operations, normalized duality, perverse truncation and intermediate extension. Total Ext finiteness and preservation of simplicity under scalar extension are not asserted.

seams_checked.note: The constructibility and injective-model imports preserve finite-rank cohomology, algebraic witnessing stratifications and AC. The draft constant-sheaf comparison was opened; its metric and contractible-open-basis hypotheses are verified for the frame spaces and projective-space example.

Opened the ordinary six-operation, Verdier, ordinary perverse and shifted smooth-pullback suppliers. The equivariant transport preserves their constructible domains. Six-functor Proof 1.1 explicitly obtains the general smooth exchange from supplied graph factorizations and finite affine-open descent. The shifts [2d] and [d] are used consistently.

Opened the finite conical supplier and the relevant stratification, conical-neighborhood and triangulation statements. The batch uses individual quasi-projective models and finite affine-open globalization, without requiring simultaneous triangulation of arbitrary maps or a compact realization of a noncompact variety.

Opened the derived-incidence, ordinary tensor–Hom and locally split simplicial-descent arguments. Local product comparisons retain their finite-model hypotheses and units; principal-bundle descent uses actual algebraic sections. No augmentation of the general action nerve to X or global bundle tensor splitting is assumed.

The characteristic-zero projective semisimplicity theorem cites Ext-theorem Proof 2.1 only for the ordinary scalar-extension argument preceding equivariant transport. Its proof separately supplies ordinary six-operation and perverse inputs; it does not infer preservation of simplicity from scalar extension.

The corollary quotes the exact Hom bound, r_N=2 min(N_i−n_i), the degree-zero ring comparison, idempotent completeness and s_N=dim_C B_N normalization. Its proof chooses the ordinary-amplitude bound before lifting projectors and uses reflection of simplicity. The zero dimension-vector case is handled separately.

The opened Borel–Moore definition, Ext dictionary, product theorem and orientation suppliers retain characteristic-zero product-GL hypotheses, normalized ω_X^G and degreewise finiteness. The stable degree correction is +2 dim_C B_N. Extraordinary exchange is used with proper maps; the refined ordinary/exceptional mate on arbitrary supports is treated as a morphism rather than an asserted isomorphism.

The current proper-descent and hypercover items have no direct citation of an assigned batch-37 item. Their actual imports are the ordinary arbitrary-field six-operation suppliers and the simplicial total-model supplier from the incidence page. Thus this declared page prerequisite does not extend batch 37's characteristic-zero equivariant statements to arbitrary coefficients or substitute locally split descent for proper descent.
